description: Population-scale waist/hip/neck/height/weight archetypes from literature cutoffs and clinical extremes — not one person. Users select nearest archetype and critique deltas toward their own measures.
references: WHO waist action levels: men 94/102 cm, women 80/88 cm (cardiometabolic risk)
NCEP/ATP III metabolic syndrome waist: men >102 cm, women >88 cm
WHR risk often cited: men >0.90, women >0.85 (WHO-class guidance)
US Navy circumference BF method (Hodgdon & Beckett) — used as composition estimator
NHANES adult waist distribution class (approx): ~P5–P95 roughly 70–130+ cm depending on sex/era
Clinical super-obesity case series: waist circumferences reported >150–180 cm (rare tails)
Athletic lean / physique ranges: male waist often ~70–85 cm; contest extremes lower
Neck circumference obesity screening literature: men ~≥37–39 cm, women ~≥34–35 cm elevated risk class

hip_cm.note: Hip co-varies with sex and gynoid vs android pattern; pear = hip >> waist; apple = waist ≥ hip
